title: One readiness register for the 73-line brief, with every peer register's answer shown
method: Rows are the 73 requirement lines of the 2026-11-15 brief in the readiness register's wording. The three status columns are read from three peer files and never merged into one verdict; 'statuses_agree' is computed by normalising their vocabularies (met=implemented, not_started=open, in_progress=open). Evidence paths are resolved against the tree by engine/register.py.
policy: A row is only 'clear to rely on' when the three registers agree AND its evidence paths resolve AND it names an official source. This file does not upgrade any status; the owner decides which register is authoritative.

rows.requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.gate: DR-G1 official/archived pre-kickoff price source for market_open; store itself runs
rows.clearing_number: opens+close captured for every originated market per week (2026 target n=284 games x 3 markets)
rows.source_note: nfl.com schedule = canonical game identity for every snapshot row
rows.evidence_text: nfl-book data/price_snapshots.json (39 open/close snapshots, 13 games x 3 markets); nfl-markets price-snapshot store 12,573 rows (4,191 games x side/total/ML) with open/close/diff columns; nfl-core, nfl-marketboard, nfl-price-snapshot, nfl-ledger maintain parallel stores
rows.round2_evidence: Store exists: nfl-book/data/price_snapshots.json holds 39 open/close pairs (13 Week-11 games x side/total/moneyline). Every market_open_value and market_close_value is null by policy (no official price source). The 'close' value is a model run trained on the 137 feed games, not a market close. Downgraded from met because the market half is blank.

rows.evidence_text: nfl-book data/results_feed.json (137 settled 2026 games, V-01/V-02/V-03 checks); nfl-markets verified feed 4,056 played games 2011-2026 with official game-page link per row; THIS SESSION re-verified 9 of 14 Week-10 finals live against nfl.com/schedules
rows.round2_evidence: Round 2 reconciled the feed to the official standings: Weeks 1-9 (136 games) match 32 of 32 clubs on W, L, T, PF and PA (RC-11). The feed holds 1 of the 14 official Week-10 finals (RC-12). 105 of its 137 rows are aggregate-only, not re-read game by game. Downgraded from met until the 13 missing finals are added and the aggregate-only rows are re-read.
